name: Mattaniah
overview: Mattaniah was a male member of the tribe of Levi, known primarily as the grandfather of Hanan_7. His role within the Levitical lineage highlights his place in the priestly tribe, though specific details about his life and ministry are limited.
namesAndTitles: The name Mattaniah means 'gift of y-h-v-h,' reflecting a theophoric element common in Hebrew names that acknowledges God's gracious provision. This proper name underscores a recognition of divine blessing, though it was not explicitly given by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Mattaniah as the son of Levi and the father of Zaccur, making him the grandfather of Hanan_7. These relationships situate him within a Levitical family line, emphasizing his heritage and connection to priestly service.
scriptureSignificance: Mattaniah's significance lies in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Levi, which was entrusted with sacred duties in Israel. Being the grandfather of Hanan_7, he contributes to the continuity of Levitical leadership and faithful service described in Nehemiah. Though not prominent in narrative events, his mention preserves the lineage important to God's covenantal promises.
